# Nevatal

> Independent AI Studio building AI workspaces, grounded retrieval tools, learning platforms, and developer utilities.

## Main Services
- Nevatal Studio: https://nevatal.id
- Nevatal Chat Workspace: https://chat.nevatal.id
- Courses & Education: https://chat.nevatal.id/courses
- GitHub: https://github.com/thirza258/nevatal

## Agent Endpoints
- API Catalog: https://nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Auth Guide: https://nevatal.id/auth.md
- Agent Card: https://nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- MCP Server Card: https://nevatal.id/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Agent Skills: https://nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- OAuth Protected Resource: https://nevatal.id/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- OAuth Authorization Server: https://nevatal.id/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
